title: Residential Painting in Alachua, FL | House Painters
description: Residential painting in Alachua, FL: whole-home repaints inside and out for Turkey Creek, Savannah Station, and large-lot homes. You stay home while we work.
heroIntro: Whole-home repaints for families in Alachua, with the interior and exterior planned together and the household still living there while we work.

sections.h2: Painting a house that's still lived in
body: Most residential painting in Alachua, FL happens around a busy household, with kids leaving for school and dogs in the yard. Nobody wants to move out for a week. So the crew tackles a single room, shifts and drapes what's in it, then moves to the next. Outside, they mask glass, hardware, plantings, and the driveway before any spraying starts. Breakfast, homework, and bedtime carry on as usual.

Our company is locally owned and works out of nearby Newberry, so neighborhoods like Savannah Station, Heritage Oaks, Turkey Creek, and Cinnamon Hills are streets we know well. Read more on our Alachua city page.

sections.h2: Planning the inside and outside together
body: Some homeowners do both halves at once, and some split them. Either way, we plan them together. Alachua exteriors go best from October through May, but the inside of the house has no season. Lots of families here have us paint indoors while the summer storms roll through, then move outside after the fall weather calms down. If you're on a deadline, crews can do both at the same time.
The exterior side of an Alachua repaint covers washing, carpentry, and elevation-by-elevation prep. The interior side covers drywall, sheen choices, and room order.

Many subdivisions require approval before an exterior color change. Bring us the approved chip, or point to a wall already painted that shade, and we'll match it and roll out full-size drawdowns. That gives the review board and your neighbors a real sample instead of a two-inch swatch. Our guide to HOA painting requirements covers what most boards ask a contractor to provide, including a certificate of insurance.

bullets: Washing, scraping, sanding, and mildew treatment ahead of the first coat of primer
Rotted trim and fascia cut out and rebuilt, never just painted
Re-caulking at every joint that moves
Two full coats of Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore, the specific product written on your quote
Low-VOC paint for kids' rooms and the nursery
A final walk you sign off on, and labelled leftover paint for touch-ups

body: Expect about one day for a typical bedroom. Doing every room inside an Alachua house takes three days on the short end and two weeks on the long end, depending on how big it is and how much patching it needs. The outside runs three to seven working days, not counting the wash and drying time. Your timeline is part of the written quote, and that quote generally shows up one business day after we walk the house.

faqs.q: Will my family have to leave while you paint our Alachua house?
faqs.a: No. The crew relocates and covers furniture, handles one room at a time, and tidies up before leaving each afternoon, so you can keep living there the whole time.

faqs.q: Can you paint the interior now and the exterior later?
faqs.a: Yes. We can split the quote into inside and outside, letting you book the interior for summer and hold the exterior until the October through May season.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on an Alachua house repaint?
faqs.a: Yes. Our written workmanship warranty sits alongside whatever the paint manufacturer covers, and on exterior work it runs as long as 10 years.

faqs.q: Do you supply what my HOA needs?
faqs.a: Yes. Your association can get an insurance certificate made out in its name, and we'll paint large color drawdowns for any review board that wants a real sample.
